scope: Local Shader Library using the saved project folder or its Project Settings override and the normal Media file-drop workflow.

windows.result: The library filtered ordinary text, JSON and images. Dragging each supported shader format into Medias created a File-mode Channel with the exact path. The GLSL import undid and redid in one step. GLSL, ISF, ShaderToy and the reopened ShaderToy binding produced exact pixels.
windows.fileExplorerRegression: Project folder, override, Tree View, Thumbnail View, PNG drop and Undo all passed.

fixtureCorrection: The first run verified the GLSL import but expected the wrong serialized spelling for the absolute path tag. The corrected fixture re-ran against the same app build.
remaining: ShaderToy, ISF and FragCoord.XYZ online browsing and import remain in M18/4.
